title: Audit
description: The tamper-evident event log — every recorded decision and action, searchable and independently verifiable.

investigate.title: Ask a question
investigate.scopeHint: Scoped to the {count, plural, one {# active filter} other {# active filters}} above.
investigate.scopeHintAll: Scoped to all of this workspace's audit events (no filters currently applied).
investigate.placeholder: e.g. Why was the endpoint-isolation action denied for this agent?
investigate.unavailable: No AI response is available right now — the advisory service was unreachable. This isn't an error with your question; try again in a moment.
investigate.inProgressHint: This can take a while — {seconds}s elapsed.

verify.valid: Chain intact — every event's hash and linkage verified.

export.description: Signed export of matching events plus their full context (agents, tasks, delegations, policy versions, approvals, grants, tool invocations). At least one filter is required.

detail.noPreviousHash: None — this is the first event in the chain.
detail.timelineHint: Every recorded event sharing this event's correlation ID, in sequence order.
detail.timelineEmpty: No other events share this correlation ID.
detail.notFoundBody: No event with this ID was found within the searched range — it may be older than this console's search depth, or the ID may be invalid.
